verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud advertises AI-powered capabilities such as Grafana Assistant and Investigations, plus natural-language understanding of production systems. The Knowledge Graph continuously generates insights about errors, anomalies and failures, and incident response lets responders investigate with the metrics, logs and traces that fired the alert. None of the evidence explicitly says the product produces AI-written summaries of incidents or alert context for responders. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-generated incident or alert summaries, details on how Investigations or Assistant summarize context for responders, and hands-on or community corroboration.
